svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step two wide open holes go down through a flat pale oxide, one to a metal line and one to a raised thin plate. After it three films cover the whole top and fill the holes: a thin purple film lining the oxide, the walls and the floors, a very thick silver film that closes each hole, and another thin purple film, with a shallow dip over each hole.

svg.text: An underlayer, a thick aluminium–copper and a cap are
sputtered over the whole wafer and into the open vias.
After: the metal-5 stack, into the vias
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
